page.overview:
Who is Catala Lucanvalle?

Catala held the position for twenty-six years until her resignation in . She was Kiyosa Natomo's successor and Elise Strang's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Her resignation and retirement were, supposedly, of free will. The fact is that she was guarded until her death in . She had been a strong Amyrlin.

When she retired, approximately half the Hall resigned. These events were caused by one rebellion buried in the Tower's secret records.
